notes.title: Patch: Save System Fix
notes.content:
I've tracked down and fixed an error with one of the scripts that was deleting game data around the start of "Chapter 3". From my testing all scenes now save and the endings are accurate to the choices made throughout the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40732336/9094144bdc806ed1b8706821fddd6d4c53de2c30.png[/img]

After this I'm planning on fixing a few things I've found and get back into the localization system.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40732336/e60245f7c0ac3f433018d959062d96a0be882f59.png[/img]

More updates coming soon

notes.title: Witching Hour Needs Voice Actors!
notes.content:
A large part of the game is focused around the conversations that happen between the three members of the Weatherby family (Rose, Richard, and Emma).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40732336/a7a4bcddcf9f32cf117f15b0f9010470ae916d5c.jpg[/img]

The first role is [i]Richard Weatherby[/i], the single father of Rose and Emma Weatherby, he's relocated the family onto his parent's farm and is teaching the girls to live off the land. His motivations for the move are unknown to the girls, but they think it's connected to an illness he has been struggling with.

[list]
[*] An older man (late 50s to early 60s) that cares deeply for the future of his daughters
[*] Is ill, but hides it with a strong facade (occasional prompts in the script for: cough, tired, clearing throat)
[*] A quiet but confident demeanor that reassures those around him
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40732336/da93f7819096b46c0c0d5f1ee18d7bb6d4bf1043.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40732336/d5a28fc13805fd43b0ef54d8963dd2fbd3dec11e.png[/img]

[i]Emma Weatherby[/i] is the little sister to the protagonist. She sometimes joins on trips around the town and is a supporting role throughout Witching Hour.
[list]
[*] Between the ages of 8 - 10
[*] Is bratty or condescending to her sister Rose (the protagonist)
[*] Gets bored of chores/working quickly, would prefer to be drawing in her room alone
[*] Confident and quiet, but antisocial
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40732336/95b9d4046c6e23ce1f68992e527ec1f80afa620a.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40732336/fa499f8fce900449fdc8bc49cbb7cc0d8d9ea97d.png[/img]

If you are or know any voice actors the link to the roles is here: https://www.castingcall.club/projects/witching-hour-2022 

All the best,
VL

@VincentLade
